==20%==
What six letters come next to complete the puzzle?

LQVVHA, MRWWIB, NSXXJC, OTYYKD, '''PUZZLE'''

Each set of letters in the sequence is one letter after the previous set: O becomes P, T becomes U and so on to spell PUZZLE.

==15%==
If you count from 1 to 30 inclusive, how many numbers have exactly three syllables?

'''10''': 11, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 28, 29

==10%==
In total, how many vowels are there in the names of countries below?

GREASE HUNGRY SP'''AI'''N

'''2''': Spain is the only country in this list.

==5%==
There is a five-letter word where if you remove the first letter a bit remains, if you remove the second letter that bit is still there, and if you take away the third letter it continues to be in place. What is the word?

'''Habit''' becomes ‘a bit’, then ‘bit’, then ‘it’

==1%==
In this sequence what number would logically come next

2 4 8 4 6 5 9 4 '''4'''

The number sequence relates to the number of letters in the words in the question. Next has four letters.
